description: This PHP source file defines the OAuthClientAPI class, part of the OrangeHRM system, which implements REST API endpoints for managing OAuth client entities including listing, creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting OAuth clients. It includes validation rules, Swagger annotations for API documentation, and utilizes traits and models for interacting with OAuth client data.

classes.name: OAuthClientAPI
classes.description: This class provides REST API endpoints for managing OAuth client entities within the OrangeHRM system, including listing, creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting OAuth clients. It utilizes OAuthServiceTrait for business logic, includes Swagger annotations for API documentation, and enforces validation rules for requests.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all OAuth clients, applying sorting, filtering, and pagination. Returns a collection result with OAuth client models and total count.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new OAuth client, generating a client ID and secret if confidential, and saving the entity.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove one or more OAuth clients based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific OAuth client by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing OAuth client, managing secret regeneration if confidentiality status changes.

methods.name: setOAuthClient
methods.description: Sets properties of an OAuth client entity based on request parameters.

methods.name: generateSecret
methods.description: Generates a secure random secret for OAuth clients.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing OAuth clients, mainly for sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating an OAuth client.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for deleting OAuth clients, validating IDs and excluding mobile clients.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a single OAuth client by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating an OAuth client, including unique property checks.
